first, last = input().split()

# The earliest login always uses:
# - the shortest possible non-empty prefix of last name: last[0]
# - the shortest prefix of first name that remains lexicographically optimal
#
# Start with the first character of the first name, and keep adding characters
# while the next character is strictly smaller than the first character of last name.
# Then append the first character of the last name.

result = first[0]
i = 1
while i < len(first) and first[i] < last[0]:
    result += first[i]
    i += 1

result += last[0]
print(result)
